title: Fix GitHub Actions pnpm setup for release publishing

context.summary: Fix the first public release workflow failure after pushing v0.1.0.
context.background: The GitHub Release workflow failed in actions/setup-node because pnpm was not installed before enabling pnpm cache.

in: Install pnpm before setup-node cache in CI and Release workflows.
Validate the task registry and repository checks.
Keep the change limited to release workflow setup.
out: Changing release signing keys or repository secrets.

acceptance_criteria: CI workflow installs pnpm before setup-node pnpm cache is configured.
Release workflow installs pnpm before setup-node pnpm cache is configured.
Task registry includes TASK-114 and validates.
pnpm check passes locally before merge.

manual_checks: Confirm the failed GitHub Release workflow error was Unable to locate executable file: pnpm.

risks: The next release workflow run may uncover a later CI-only issue after pnpm setup succeeds.
definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
